normalization: Dorsal mantle length ML = 1, eye-centre plane to posterior mantle along the dorsal axis. Review pose rotates mantle rigidly 45 degrees about the eye midpoint; normalization is measured along the rotated axis.
arm_length_definition: mouth opening to tip along oral midline; model construction guide plus final skin projection
web_depth_definition: mouth to midpoint/shallowest free-edge point in each inter-arm sector, oral view; maximum divided by longest arm length

reference_ranges.arm_formula: II=I>III>IV, nearly equal; ventral IV shortest
reference_ranges.web_order: lateral deeper; dorsal A and ventral E shallowest

target_selection: 4.0 and 0.23 are arithmetic midpoints of published ranges. 3.9/3.8 arm targets and 0.20/0.22 shallow-sector targets are explicit engineering interpolation to express the published near-equality/order, not measured specimen numbers. No species-wide exact values claimed.

sources.role: arm numbering, mantle landmarks and oral web-depth definition

still_unknown: individual animal dimensions, age and sex
exact sector-to-sector web depth and arm-length differences in a particular specimen
final display scale and deformation behaviour
width/thickness metrics not calibrated in this proportional-length repair

review_pose.basis: Unmeasured display pose chosen to expose dorsal web A, not a specimen angle.
